column1: # IVA rate codes (CodigoTarifaIVA / Tarifa) — versioned reference data
# CATALOGUE VERSION: 2026.08.07-subset
# STATUS: ILLUSTRATIVE SUBSET. NOT THE OFFICIAL CATALOGUE.
# The authoritative rate-code table is an annex to the electronic-receipt
# resolution for version 4.4 (Resolución MH-DGT-RES-0027-2024). Costa Rica's IVA
# has a 13% general rate plus several reduced and transitional rates
# carrying its own code. Reduced rates attach to specific goods and services
# (health services
# and so on) and the mapping from product to rate is decided by the CABYS code
# not by this file.
# This subset exists so the validation layer can answer one narrow question:
# "is the rate code on this synthetic line a code the catalogue knows about
# does the stated percentage match that code?" It does NOT encode which rate a
# given product is entitled to. Do not use it to decide what to charge.
# TODO(verify): reconcile every row against the current v4.4 annex before this
# repo is used for anything other than synthetic data.
# COLUMNS
#   rate_code       Two-digit code as carried in the XML
#   rate_percent    Percentage the code represents
#   description     Spanish description
#   grants_credit   true if IVA at this code is creditable by the receiver
rate_code
